user.title: Configure Sapir Parking
user.description: How do you want to sign in to Sapir Parking?

login.title: Sign in with phone number
login.description: Use the same details you use to sign in on the Sapir Parking website. The integration signs in again by itself when the session expires.

data_description.phone: The phone number registered with Sapir Parking.
data_description.license: The car license plate registered with Sapir Parking.
data_description.flaresolverr_url: Optional. Address of a FlareSolverr instance, for example http://192.168.1.10:8191. Used only when Cloudflare blocks a request.

cookie.title: Sign in with a session cookie
cookie.description: Sign in on the Sapir Parking website, then copy the value of the `session` cookie from your browser's developer tools (Application → Cookies). You'll need to do this again when the cookie expires.

data_description.session_cookie: The value of the `session` cookie for sapirparking.com.
data_description.flaresolverr_url: Optional. Address of a FlareSolverr instance, for example http://192.168.1.10:8191. Used only when Cloudflare blocks a request.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Sapir Parking again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Sapir Parking session expired or the saved details stopped working. Enter them again.

error.invalid_auth: Couldn't sign in with these details.
error.cloudflare_challenge: Cloudflare blocked the request. Add a FlareSolverr URL to get past it.
error.flaresolverr_unreachable: Couldn't reach FlareSolverr at this address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: Sapir Parking is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Sapir Parking is already set up.

data_description.flaresolverr_url: Address of a FlareSolverr instance, for example http://192.168.1.10:8191. Leave empty to turn it off.

error.invalid_auth: Couldn't sign in with the saved details.
error.cloudflare_challenge: Cloudflare still blocked the request through this FlareSolverr.
error.flaresolverr_unreachable: Couldn't reach FlareSolverr at this address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

not_loaded.message: Sapir Parking isn't set up or isn't loaded.

already_reserved.message: A parking spot is already reserved for {date}.

not_reserved.message: No parking spot is reserved for {date}.

get_available_spots.name: Get available spots
get_available_spots.description: Lists the free parking spots, grouped by floor.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date to check. Defaults to today. Only today and tomorrow are supported.

get_status.name: Get status
get_status.description: Gets the reservation status and free spots for a date.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date to check. Defaults to today. Only today and tomorrow are supported.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date to release the spot for. Defaults to today. Only today and tomorrow are supported.

reserve_parking_spot.name: Reserve parking spot
reserve_parking_spot.description: Reserves a parking spot. Tries the parking ID first, then the preferred spots in order, then picks a random free spot.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date to reserve for. Defaults to today. Only today and tomorrow are supported.

parking_id.name: Parking ID
parking_id.description: The ID of a specific spot to reserve. If it isn't free, the action fails.

preferred_spots.name: Preferred spots
preferred_spots.description: A list of floor/spot pairs to try in order. If none are free, a random spot is reserved.
